options.reason: The table is the UCI steel-plate fault set: geometric, luminosity and index descriptors of an inspected plate region plus seven binary defect flags (Pastry, Z_Scratch, K_Scatch, Stains, Dirtiness, Bumps, Other_Faults). Several categorical outcomes describe the same row, so they are joint multilabel targets rather than features. TypeOfSteel_A400 is the exact complement recoding of TypeOfSteel_A300 and is dropped as redundant; Y_Minimum/Y_Maximum are near-unique per-row keys and are excluded from features.
options.title: multilabel

options.reason: If the flags are one-hot of a single fault type, Other_Faults is the catch-all outcome to predict; the remaining fault flags are then components of the same recorded label and are excluded as leakage suspects.
options.title: binary
